label: class_a_05_ecology_01
text: Hello, hello. I hope everyone’s ready to learn\nsome new things today![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_02
text: You all did really great on the midterm exam![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_03
text: Thanks for answering my little question at the\nend, too.\c\nI’ll be sure to keep your responses in mind.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_04
text: All right! We’re now heading into the last half\nof our classes together.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_05
text: It’s time for our knowledge to evolve and grow—\njust like our Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_06
text: Evolution...yep. Haha! Evolution![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_07
text: Today we’re going to learn about the fascinating\nphenomenon of Pokémon Evolution![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_08
text: As your Pokémon battle and level up, they learn\nmoves and get stronger.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_09
text: And for some Pokémon, once they’ve leveled up\nenough...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_10
text: their appearance changes, and their stats\nincrease—sometimes by a lot![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_11
text: That’s Pokémon Evolution![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_12
text: Pokémon become very strong when they evolve,\nmaking them trusty partners in battle.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_13
text: But! Some people prefer to keep their Pokémon\nin their adorable pre-evolved states.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_14
text: To do this, you just need to remember a certain\nbutton when your Pokémon begins to evolve.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_15
text: Say it with me if you already know! To cancel\nEvolution, press the...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_16
text: The button you want when you need to stop a\nPokémon from evolving is the B Button![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_17
text: If you press this button soon after a Pokémon\nbegins to evolve, you can stop it from changing.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_18
text: You can also let the Pokémon hold an item known\nas an Everstone to keep it from evolving.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_19
text: And keep in mind that the requirements for\nEvolution differ from Pokémon to Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_20
text:
Some may evolve by having a certain item, such
as a Fire Stone or Thunder Stone, used on them.\c
Others may have to learn a specific move or
defeat a specific Pokémon in battle to evolve.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_21
text: The way Primeape evolves into Annihilape is\nespecially strange.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_22
text: You see, there’s a certain move that—[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_23
text: Whoops. Sorry, looks like we’re out of time![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_05_ecology_24
text: I guess we’ll have to end the class there today.\nThank you all for your attention![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
